title: Will Stale Signature Alert
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=will:status years_since_signed=* will_status=*
| where years_since_signed>=5 OR will_status="needs_update"
| sort - years_since_signed
| table jurisdiction years_since_signed beneficiary_count will_status
description: Flags wills signed five or more years ago or marked as needing update.
value: Life changes make old wills dangerous; stale-signature alerts prompt reviews after births, moves, or divorces.
implementation: Track `years_since_signed` and `will_status` on each will export and schedule reviews after major life events.
visualization: Table of wills ranked by years since signed.
grandmaExplanation: It watches wills that are old enough they probably do not match your life anymore.
